name: 77092 · Houston, TX
findings: ZIP 77092 (Houston) has 116 nonprofit organizations. 62 of them (53%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 48 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 77092 (Houston) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 77092 (Houston) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 48 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
